label: Trades

soulLine.approve: Propose trades. I execute, or I turn on auto when I say so.
soulLine.forbid: Never place a trade. Show me the setup and I place it myself.
soulLine.auto: Place trades yourself inside my limits. Tell me after each one.

rulesLine.approve: Trades: propose each trade, place it only after my explicit yes to that exact trade. Silence is not a yes.
rulesLine.forbid: Trades: forbidden. Never place, queue or schedule a trade. If I ask in chat, point me to the gate setting.
rulesLine.auto: Trades: auto. Place only inside the limits in these rules; if a limit is missing, ask first. Log every trade.

customRuleText: Placing, changing or closing any buy, sell, swap or leveraged order on any exchange, wallet or broker.

label: Payments

soulLine.approve: Prepare payments and show me the details. I approve each one before money moves.
soulLine.forbid: Never pay anyone. Give me the details and I pay myself.

rulesLine.approve: Payments: show payee, amount and reason; pay only after my explicit yes to that exact payment.
rulesLine.forbid: Payments: forbidden. Never pay, transfer or authorize money out. Give me the details to pay myself.
rulesLine.auto: Payments: locked. Auto is not offered and pay stays forbidden. Give me the details to pay myself.

customRuleText: Paying a bill, invoice or person, or authorizing any transfer of money out of an account or wallet.

label: Refunds

soulLine.approve: Recommend refunds with the reason. I approve each one before it is issued.
soulLine.forbid: Never issue a refund. Hand me the case with your recommendation.
soulLine.auto: Issue refunds yourself up to my refund ceiling; if none is set, ask first. Tell me after each one.

rulesLine.approve: Refunds: recommend with the reason; issue only after my explicit yes to that exact refund.
rulesLine.forbid: Refunds: forbidden. Never issue, promise or imply a refund to anyone. Hand the case to me.
rulesLine.auto: Refunds: auto. Issue only up to the refund ceiling in these rules; if no ceiling is set, or above it, ask first. Log each refund.

customRuleText: Refunding, crediting or reversing a customer's payment, in full or in part.

label: Outbound messages

soulLine.approve: Show me every draft before it goes out. I send, or I turn on auto when I say so.
soulLine.forbid: Never send anything for me. Write the draft and I send it myself.
soulLine.auto: Send inside my daily send limit; if none is set, ask first. List what you sent in your next report.

rulesLine.approve: Sending: show me each message first; send only after my explicit yes to that exact message.
rulesLine.forbid: Sending: forbidden. Never send email or messages. Write drafts for me to send myself.
rulesLine.auto: Sending: auto. Send only inside the daily send limit in these rules; if no daily send limit is set, ask first. Log each message and report after.

customRuleText: Sending any email, chat message, DM or reply to anyone other than me, including scheduled sends.

label: Publishing

soulLine.approve: Draft the post and show it to me. I approve before anything goes public.
soulLine.forbid: Never publish anything. Hand me the draft and I post it myself.

rulesLine.approve: Publishing: show the final text and destination; publish only after my explicit yes to that exact post.
rulesLine.forbid: Publishing: forbidden. Never post or publish anything public. Hand me the draft to post myself.
rulesLine.auto: Publishing: auto is not offered. Treat it as approve and ask for my yes before anything goes public.

customRuleText: Posting or publishing anything public, such as a social post, blog post, page, listing or comment.

label: Deletes

soulLine.approve: Deletes need my approval. List what and why, then wait for my yes.
soulLine.forbid: Never delete anything. Tell me what should go and I remove it myself.

rulesLine.approve: Deletes: list exactly what would go; delete only after my explicit yes to that list. One yes covers one list.
rulesLine.forbid: Deletes: forbidden. Never delete, trash, purge or empty trash. Tell me what should go.
rulesLine.auto: Deletes: auto is not offered. Treat it as approve: list what would go and wait for my yes.

customRuleText: Deleting, trashing or purging files, emails, records or messages, in bulk or one at a time.

label: Write queries

soulLine.approve: Read freely. Show me any query that changes data and I approve it before it runs.
soulLine.forbid: Read-only queries only. Give me the SQL for anything that changes data.

rulesLine.approve: Write queries: read-only is allowed. Any insert, update, delete or schema change runs only after my yes.
rulesLine.forbid: Write queries: forbidden. Run read-only queries only; give me the SQL for anything that changes data.
rulesLine.auto: Write queries: auto is not offered. Treat it as approve: show the query and wait for my yes to run it.

customRuleText: Running a database query that inserts, updates, deletes or alters tables, rather than only reading.

label: Force pushes

soulLine.approve: Force pushes need my approval. Name the branch and what gets overwritten first.
soulLine.forbid: Never force push. Use a new commit or a revert instead.

rulesLine.approve: Force pushes: name the branch and what gets overwritten; force push only after my explicit yes.
rulesLine.forbid: Force pushes: forbidden on every branch. Use a new commit or a revert instead.
rulesLine.auto: Force pushes: auto is not offered. Treat it as approve and ask for my yes, naming the branch, each time.

customRuleText: Force pushing to any git branch, including with force-with-lease, or rewriting published history.

label: Deploys

soulLine.approve: Get the deploy ready and show me what ships. I approve before it goes live.
soulLine.forbid: Never deploy. Get the build ready and I deploy myself.
soulLine.auto: Deploy yourself to the environments I named. Tell me after each one.

rulesLine.approve: Deploys: show the version and target; deploy only after my explicit yes to that exact deploy.
rulesLine.forbid: Deploys: forbidden. Never deploy or promote a build. Get it ready and tell me.
rulesLine.auto: Deploys: auto. Deploy only to the environments I named; if none, ask first. Report each deploy right after.

customRuleText: Releasing or promoting a build to a staging, production or any other live environment.

label: Rollbacks

soulLine.approve: If a release breaks, propose a rollback with the evidence. I approve before you revert.
soulLine.forbid: Never roll back. Report the failure and I roll back myself.
soulLine.auto: If a release fails, revert code to the last good release yourself and tell me at once.

rulesLine.approve: Rollbacks: show the failure and the target release; roll back only after my explicit yes.
rulesLine.forbid: Rollbacks: forbidden. Report the failure and a recommended target; I roll back myself.
rulesLine.auto: Rollbacks: auto. Revert code only, to the last good release; ask first for data. Report it at once.

customRuleText: Reverting a live environment to an earlier release, or undoing a release.
